_comment: English lives under /en/. Slugs stay identical to PT — assets/js/i18n.js derives the switcher URL by stripping and re-adding the prefix, so a page must sit at the same path in every language. Keys under ui.* map to {{S_*}} placeholders in shell.html.

ui.ogImageAlt: Ponte em Cena — Cultural Connections 2026 — truss bridge running green (Brazil) to gold (the meeting point) to orange (Netherlands)

pages.title: Ponte em Cena — cultural exchange Brazil ⇄ Netherlands
pages.ogTitle: Ponte em Cena — cultural exchange Brazil ⇄ Netherlands
pages.description: Ponte em Cena is a cultural exchange methodology between Brazil and the Netherlands, crossing Augusto Boal's Theatre of the Oppressed with Dutch design methods. A series of workshops through 2026.
pages.ogDescription: A cultural exchange methodology between Brazil and the Netherlands. Theatre of the Oppressed meeting Dutch design.

metodologia.title: Methodology — Theatre of the Oppressed and Dutch design | Ponte em Cena
metodologia.ogTitle: The method: Brazilian theatre as the engine of a Dutch design process
metodologia.description: The foundations of the method: Augusto Boal's Theatre of the Oppressed (Newspaper Theatre, Image Theatre, Legislative Theatre) and the Dutch reflective layer — Context Mapping, Kleurendenken and Frame Creation.
metodologia.ogDescription: Boal meets Delft: how theatre becomes the generative session and Dutch design becomes the lens.

oficinas.title: The three workshops — diagnose, generate, decide | Ponte em Cena
oficinas.description: Diagnose, generate, decide. Three workshops crossing Augusto Boal's Theatre of the Oppressed with Dutch design methods. The subject of each cycle is chosen together with the Consulate.
oficinas.ogDescription: Diagnose, generate, decide. The movement defines the workshop; the subject is chosen with the Consulate.

sobre.title: About the project — Cultural Connections 2026 | Ponte em Cena
sobre.description: Who runs Ponte em Cena, how the project came about, and what two hundred years of Brazilian-Dutch friendship have to do with a rehearsal room in São Paulo.
sobre.ogDescription: Regen Studio and (in)PULSO, supported by the Consulate-General of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in São Paulo.

contato.title: Contact | Ponte em Cena
contato.ogTitle: Get in touch with Ponte em Cena
contato.description: How to reach Ponte em Cena — to join a workshop, propose a partnership, or find out more about the method.
contato.ogDescription: To take part, propose a partnership, or find out more about the method.

404.title: Page not found | Ponte em Cena
404.description: This page does not exist, or it has moved.

privacidade.title: Privacy — what we collect and what we do not | Ponte em Cena
privacidade.description: What this site collects, what it does not, and how we handle the material produced in workshops. No cookies, no third-party tracker. LGPD and GDPR.
privacidade.ogDescription: No cookies, no third-party tracker. What we collect, and what happens to workshop material.

diagnosticar.title: Workshop 01 · Diagnose — Newspaper Theatre and the crossed reading
diagnosticar.ogTitle: Diagnose: reading the same story from both sides
diagnosticar.description: The first Ponte em Cena workshop. Two news reports on the same subject, one from each country, read in parallel through Newspaper Theatre, Context Mapping and Kleurendenken.

gerar.title: Workshop 02 · Generate — Forum Theatre and the reframe
gerar.ogTitle: Generate: staging the deadlock, then reframing it
gerar.description: The second Ponte em Cena workshop. A deadlock staged, an audience that intervenes, and the Frame Creation step that asks which lever nobody reached for.

espect-ator.name: Spect-actor
espect-ator.description: The person watching also acts: steps into the scene, replaces the protagonist and tries another route. The figure the whole method is named after.

curinga.name: Curinga
curinga.description: The facilitator. Guides without teaching which reading is the right one, and makes sure no single perspective takes over the room.

cena-modelo.name: Model scene
cena-modelo.description: The scene showing a problem that does not resolve. It is played a second time so the audience can interrupt it.

imagem-real-desejada.name: Real image and desired image
imagem-real-desejada.description: Two sculptures made from the bodies in the group: the situation as it is, and as they wish it were. What has to change sits between the two.

dinamizacao.name: Dynamisation
dinamizacao.description: Setting a still image in motion, to see which forces it holds and where it tends to go.

sessao-generativa.name: Generative session
sessao-generativa.description: In Context Mapping, the exercise that reaches what interviews cannot. In Ponte em Cena, theatre is that session.

camada-tacita.name: Tacit and latent layers
camada-tacita.description: What people know without knowing they know it, and what they have not yet put into words. The two deepest layers of the Delft model.

caderno-sensibilizacao.name: Sensitising booklet
caderno-sensibilizacao.description: Material sent out days before the workshop so the group arrives already observing their own lives. Thin homework, thick collage.

cor-ausente.name: The absent colour
cor-ausente.description: In Kleurendenken, the route to change that nobody reached for. Usually more diagnostic than the dominant colour.

paradoxo.name: Paradox
paradoxo.description: In Frame Creation, the formulation that jams the problem: we need X, but X prevents Y. Step 2 of the nine.

campo.name: Field
campo.description: Step 4: the wider terrain of actors, values and forces around the problem. In Ponte em Cena these are bodies in the field, not a map.

quadro.name: Frame
quadro.description: Step 6, the pivot: the new framing from which different solutions become possible.

linha-de-captura.name: Capture line
linha-de-captura.description: The sentence recording each Forum Theatre intervention: tried [action] by appealing to [value, actor or lever]. Then you ask which lever nobody reached for.
